_what: Per-building measured window grids. js/facades.js's registerMeasuredGrids reads this and derives rows/cols/opening size from it; anything not listed here keeps the seven height-class templates.
_why_empty:
DELIBERATELY EMPTY, and there is no scripts/bake_facade_grids.py in this repo for the same reason. The mechanism is a LANDMARK mechanism, not a fabric one: registerMeasuredGrids hands each listed building its own family code k0..kz and refuses past 36 of them, because every measured building costs an atlas image pair. Austin's file carries sixteen buildings, each with a storey count and a window aspect read off a licensed photograph.

The obvious cheap substitute here does not work and was checked rather than assumed. `num_floors` is present on only 416 of 2,220 features, and dividing final_height by it gives an implied floor-to-floor of 1.10 m at the 5th percentile and 6.80 m at the 95th — because final_height mostly comes from Overture (1,928 features) while num_floors comes from OSM levels, and the two disagree building by building. Filtering to a believable 2.8-5.2 m band leaves a few hundred, of which the mechanism could take 36 — an arbitrary 36 out of a scene of 2,220. That is not a measurement, it is a lottery, and js/facades.js's own comment on this registry ('a height class cannot tell a two-storey Beaux-Arts reading room from an eight-storey Brutalist slab, because it is not looking at either one') applies just as much to a bake that is not looking at either one.

So the file exists, empty, to (a) stop js/app.js's fetch 404ing on every load and (b) hold this note where the next person looks for it.
_the_real_finding_underneath: The template that actually matters here is `mr`, which js/facades.js sizes at 6 rows per 32.98 m repeat — a 5.50 m floor-to-floor. It is assigned to every building 5-12 m tall, which in this bbox is 1,168 features, 53% of the city, and 5.50 m is not a storey: a 9 m three-storey walk-up draws 1.6 rows of windows. `mh` next door is 8 rows, 4.12 m, and ships on 475 buildings with no shimmer report against it, so moving `mr` to 8 would be inside proven-safe density. It was NOT done in this pass because js/facades.js is byte-shared with austin-3d-explorer, docs/shimmer-mechanism.md root-causes window crawl to exactly this knob, and there was no shimmer harness running here to prove the change is free. It is the next thing to try, and it wants a measurement, not an opinion.
